items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern vector redraw of a historical script form
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 下 in Shuowen seal-script style, representing the later vertical-stroke form described in the graphic-history accounts.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing of 下 in seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The Commons file page identifies the character and seal-script style, provides the direct original SVG link, and reports a reusable public-domain/CC0 status. The database accounts differ on when the vertical stroke became established.
items.rights: The Commons page reports public domain and CC0 1.0 for this vector; its note also attributes an underlying source image to Sinica. Modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

limitations.text: The file image fetch failed, so the proposed image was not visually inspected. Use it as a modern redraw only; it does not directly document a dated specimen.
